newsitem.title: USA: Acorn Products sets IPO at $14/shr.
newsitem.headline: Acorn Products sets IPO at $14/shr.

text.p: Acorn Products Inc said it has begun an initial public offering of 3.25 million shares of common stock at $14.00 per share.

The net proceeds, estimated at about $41 million, are to be used to reduce outstanding borrowings under the company's credit facility, to redeem all outstanding shares of its preferred stock and to repay a portion of its outstanding subordinated indebtedness.
Acorn's remaining subordinated indebtedness will be exchanged for common stock at the initial public offering price.

The company's common stock is expected to open for trading on the Nasdaq National Market later today under the symbol ACRN.O. The settlement and closing of the offering is expected to take place on June 27.
Acorn manufactures and markets non-powered lawn and garden tools in the United States.
